root_idea.summary: The root centers on remaining or adhering, and on the pure or choice inner part of something.
root_idea.development: From remaining and steadfast adherence develop senses of persistence, service, and repeated response; from the inner or choicest part develop meanings for kernel, essence, and purified intellect. Several bodily, garment-related, and figurative uses extend from the chest or inner core.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the singular dictionary citation form لُبّ; the Quranic form is its plural أَلْبَاب.

senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form أَلْبَاب is the plural of لُبّ and occurs in constructions referring to people characterized by such purified understanding, including أُولُوا الْأَلْبَابِ. It is presented as a more particular kind of intellect than intellect in general.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become possessed of understanding or intelligence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verbal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To utter a cry or sound at rutting-time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a goat, and sometimes of a buck antelope.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break an almond and take out its kernel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive verbal construction with the almond or similar nut as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike someone on the upper breast or chest-pit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is struck at the part called لَبَّة, the pit between the collar-bones.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To face, stand opposite, or be directly over against another house.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of one house in relation to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw garments together at the breast, grasping or holding a person by them; by extension, to prepare oneself with weaponry or clothing for action and a call for aid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction includes seizing at the upper chest, putting a rope or garment around the neck, or gathering one's own garments.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go backwards and forwards, or to go to and fro.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative lexical explanation is recorded for the Form II use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For grain, to acquire or produce an edible heart or kernel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of grain and similar produce.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, stay, abide, or dwell in a place; to keep to a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV, used with a place or with عَلَى for continued adherence to an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For growing corn or similar plants, to bear or produce the edible substance in the grain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV agricultural use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For something to appear or present itself to someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The thing that appears is expressed as the subject and the person as the indirect object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or fit a breast-girth or breast-leather to a saddle or draught animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The equipment is attached across the breast to keep the saddle from slipping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wrap or gather clothing around the breast; to gird oneself, tuck up one's garments, or arm oneself for action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The scarf, garment, or weapon is arranged at the chest or waist; the cited woman is an illustration, not a gender restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For two people to seize or grapple with each other at the upper chest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction referring to the part called لَبَّة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take one's way through a valley.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or specialized use marked as such in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To test or make trial of someone's understanding or intelligence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X transitive construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tenderness, affection, kindness, or compassion toward offspring or another person; kindness accompanied by aid or succor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The use may describe tenderness toward young or compassionate treatment of a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become separated, dispersed, or scattered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transmitted lexical explanation is accompanied by a note proposing that the wording may instead have intended a gentleness or kindness meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Remaining, staying, keeping to, or adhering to a thing or activity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is also used in expressions of continued attendance or service; a person may be one who constantly remains with a task or craft.

other_classical_meanings.definition: At your service; I attend, obey, or respond to you repeatedly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The formula is used as a repeated response of service or obedience; related forms include لَبَّيْهِ, لَبَّى يَدَيْكَ, and لَبِّي زَيْدٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who persistently keeps to a matter, occupation, craft, or business, often with practiced skill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The phrase رَجُلٌ لَبٌّ describes steadfast professional adherence; the associated expression adds skill or expertise rather than creating a separate core sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affectionate, friendly, courteous, polite, or affable toward people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine form may describe affection toward a husband, but the lexical meaning is not restricted to women or marital relations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The inside, heart, or kernel of a nut, almond, or similar object; the pith of a palm-tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural for the botanical or edible sense is لُبُوب.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pure, choice, or best part of anything.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the selected or purified substance of food and similar things, distinct from the specialized intellect sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Certain veins in the heart, conceived as sources of tenderness, affection, kindness, or compassion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional anatomical and figurative expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The tender or affectionate feelings of the heart; figuratively, love or deep affection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression أَلْقَى عَلَيْهِ بَنَاتَ أَلْبُبِهِ, meaning that one loved or felt tenderly toward something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a poetic interpretation, the intelligent or most discerning people of a group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is an alternative interpretation of a poetic expression and is not a separate Quranic form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The self, substance, or essence of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the inner or pure part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Poison, especially the poison of a serpent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A beast of prey resembling a wolf.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional usage reported for al-Andalus and al-ʿAdwah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The breast-girth or breast-strap of a saddle, fastened across an animal's breast to prevent the saddle from slipping backward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of camel and horse tack.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ample circumstances, abundance, and security.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the idiom فِي لَبَبٍ رَخِيٍّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Broad-bosomed or broad-hearted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive expression equivalent to having a wide breast or heart.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thin tract or forepart of sand descending from a larger dune, lying between smoother and rougher ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a particular small or front portion of a sand-hill.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle or upper part of the breast, especially the pit between the collar-bones where an animal is stabbed or where a necklace lies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may refer to the breast area of a human or animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small or non-extensive amount of pasture or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for scant vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: No harm; no cause for alarm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reassuring formula, equivalent to لَا بَأْسَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The choice or best part of a group or thing; a person of outstanding quality; or pure nobility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the best people, camels, flour, or lineage according to the object named.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Finely ground flour or meal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A food term distinct from the broader sense of the purest or best part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person possessing understanding or intelligence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive noun or adjective; its broken plural is أَلِبَّاء.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Remaining or staying; in a particular poetic use, responsive or at someone's service.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited verse is interpreted either as مُقِيم or as مَلَبٍّ, so the two closely related readings are retained as alternatives.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment or drapery worn over the upper breast and shoulders by one who girds or arms himself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A clothing term associated with the chest-covering of a person preparing for action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A particular garment, compared lexically with the بَقِيرَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence identifies it as a named garment without specifying a broader clothing class.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Kind and beneficent toward one's family and neighbors.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A personal descriptive noun or adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: With the tenderest affections of one's heart; with profound love.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression for heartfelt affection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The confused noise and cries of sheep or goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural or collective sound term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An imitative word for the sound made by a he-goat at rutting-time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An onomatopoeic noun, distinct from the compassion sense of لَبْلَبَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A twining herb or leguminous plant, also used medicinally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant name, associated with a vine that climbs or embraces trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A whirl or spiraling discharge of abundant water through a narrow outlet; by extension, a water spout or tube.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The evidence notes uncertainty over whether the term is Arabic or arabicized.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The kernel of the stone of the lote-tree fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A particular edible fruit kernel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A draught animal furnished with a breast-girth or breast-leather.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical evidence records a variant form and disagreement over which derived form is preferable.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Characterized by understanding or intelligence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived descriptive form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The portion of clothing situated at the breast or chest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized clothing term; its plural is تَلَابِيب.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seize someone by the gathered clothing at the breast and drag or restrain him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional phrase also expressed with the plural تَلَابِيب.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Contains both the chest-grasp/preparation sense and an alternative back-and-forth explanation.
The transmitted scattering sense and the proposed gentleness reading are both preserved.
Verbal-noun identification covered by the remaining/staying meaning.
Specific wheat example covered by the pure or choice part meaning.
Best camels are covered by the choice or best part meaning.
Best flour is covered by the choice or pure part meaning.
Pure nobility is covered by the choice or best quality branch.
Alternative poetic interpretations are stated in the target definition.

cautions: The canonical Quran form is the plural أَلْبَاب, normalized here under the singular citation form لُبّ.

The Lane material is matched through the contracted geminate root لب; broader meanings below remain attached to their stated headwords and derived forms rather than being treated as meanings of the Quranic plural.
Some Classical entries preserve explicitly reported alternative readings or regional usages; these are identified in their usage conditions rather than presented as Quranic senses.
